text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to rescind the current alternate side parking regulations on Simpson Avenue, between Logan Avenue and Carlaw Avenue and maintain year-round parking on the north side of the street. In addition, Transportation Services is also requesting approval to provide "Island Parking" exclusively for residential permit holders at intervals along the south side of the street. The amendment will provide approximately eight additional permit parking spaces on the subject section of Simpson Avenue from April 1 to November 30, inclusive.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect, from 8:00 a.m. of the first day of each month to 8:00 a.m. of the 16th day of each month, from April 1 to November 30, inclusive and anytime, from December 1 of one year to March 31 of the next following year, inclusive on the south side of Simpson Avenue, between Logan Avenue and Carlaw Avenue. 2. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect, from 8:00 a.m. of the 16th day of each month to 8:00 a.m. of the first day of the next month, from April 1 to November 30, inclusive on the north side of Simpson Avenue, between Logan Avenue and Carlaw Avenue. 3. Rescinded the existing permit parking, in effect, at all times, from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., except no parking from 8:00 a.m. of the first day to 8:00 a.m. of the 16th day of each month, inclusive, from April 1 to November 30,…
